description:
Update a Sentry Alert (notification workflow): name, status, owner, environment, notification frequency, triggers, notification actions, and connected projects or monitors.
Read it with get_alert_rule first; get_alert_options lists valid actions, conditions, and sources. Omitted fields stay unchanged.
Metric Monitor queries and thresholds change with update_metric_monitor; cron and uptime monitors have their own tools.

actionFilters.description: Complete list of action groups with their conditions and notification actions, copied from get_alert_rule. Keep IDs and unchanged entries; omitted groups, conditions, and actions are removed.

config.description: Provider config. Slack and Teams: set targetDisplay to the channel name in the integrationId workspace; Sentry resolves the ID. Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, email: set targetIdentifier; a new display name alone keeps the old target.

addDetectorIds.description: Monitor source IDs to connect, from get_alert_options sources. An all-project source also needs org:write.

addProjectSlugs.description: Projects whose issue streams to connect.

items.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

environment.description: Environment the Alert applies to. Null means all environments.

frequencyMinutes.description: Minimum interval between notifications, in minutes.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

owner.description: Owner as user:<id> or team:<id>. Null clears it.

anyOf.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.
The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

removeProjectSlugs.description: Projects whose issue streams to disconnect. Other monitors in those projects stay connected.

items.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

ruleIdOrName.description: Alert workflow ID from get_alert_rule, or exact Alert name. Digits are treated as an ID.

triggers.description: Complete trigger group, copied from get_alert_rule. Keep existing condition IDs; omitted conditions are removed.
